text: This is the third time I'm writing about my double-charged tuition and nobody answers. If it isn't fixed this week I'll contact a lawyer.
ai_reason: The student reports a double-charged tuition fee, which falls under billing and high priority. Escalation is required due to a legal threat and unanswered repeated requests.
draft: Dear student, we understand your concern regarding the overpayment of your tuition. To resolve this, you must apply with a refund petition to the official at Student Affairs' Fees Office (Harçlar Şube Müdürlüğü). The extra amount paid is then refunded to the bank account (IBAN) in the student's name given in the petition (Source: BŞEÜ Student Affairs (Öğrenci İşleri Daire Başkanlığı), Frequently Asked Questions: Harç İşlemleri).

text: Respectfully, I believe my Physics II midterm was graded incorrectly. Question 3 was marked wrong but my answer matches the solution key. Could someone review it?

draft: To object to an exam result, you must submit a written objection to the teaching unit's management within five working days after the results are announced. Please keep in mind that exam results are only changed to correct material errors made when adding up the grades, and the unit's board decides on the objection. (Source: BŞEÜ Ön Lisans ve Lisans Eğitim-Öğretim Yönetmeliği, Article 20)

ai_reason: The student is asking about course registration after the add-drop deadline has passed, falling under registration. Escalation is true because the student needs an exception to a passed deadline (Rule 3), and priority is high as it blocks their course schedule.
draft: Merhaba, ders ekleme, bırakma ve değiştirme işlemleri danışman onayı ile yarıyıl derslerinin başlangıcını izleyen ilk hafta içinde gerçekleştirilmektedir. Öğrenciler süresi içinde usulüne uygun olarak almadıkları ya da kayıt yaptırmadıkları derslere devam edemez ve bu derslerin sınavına giremezler. Bu doğrultuda süresi geçen işlemler için ders kaydı yapılması mümkün değildir (Kaynak: Ön Lisans ve Lisans Eğitim-Öğretim Yönetmeliği, Madde 16).
